common_name: Dolce Blackcurrant Heuchera (Deep Purple-Black Coral Bells)

planting.note: Plant container divisions in spring in humus-rich, well-drained soil in partial to full shade; Dolce Blackcurrant is a Proven Winners introduction with deep purple-black foliage and a compact habit suited to shaded containers and small borders.

directions: Plant in humus-rich, well-drained soil in partial to full shade; Dolce Blackcurrant is a compact coral bells cultivar in the Proven Winners Dolce series, bearing glossy, ruffled leaves in a near-black deep purple that holds its intense color well through the season with some morning sun. Its dense, tidy mound stays small and neat without sprawling, making it especially useful for shaded container plantings, edging along a shade path, or as a dramatic dark accent tucked among chartreuse or silver-leaved companions in a mixed bed. Small pale flower spikes rise above the foliage in late spring but are secondary to the rich, glossy leaf color. Provide consistent moisture and sharp drainage, and divide congested clumps every three to four years in spring to maintain vigor.
sources: North Carolina State Extension — Heuchera for Southern Gardens

directions: Plant in humus-rich, well-drained soil in partial shade with some morning sun to develop the richest color; Dolce Peach Melba is a compact coral bells cultivar in the Proven Winners Dolce series, bearing ruffled leaves that open warm peach-orange and shift toward rosy amber as they mature, giving the compact mound a shifting, multi-toned glow through the season. Its tidy, dense growth habit stays small and neat, making it especially useful for shaded container plantings, edging along a shade path, or as a warm-toned accent among cooler purple or green companions in a mixed border. Small pale flower spikes rise above the foliage in late spring but are secondary to the warm leaf color. Provide consistent moisture and sharp drainage, and divide congested clumps every three to four years in spring to maintain vigor.

common_name: Little Cuties Peppermint Heuchera (Miniature Coral Bells)

planting.note: Plant container divisions in spring in humus-rich, well-drained soil in partial to full shade; Little Cuties Peppermint is a Proven Winners miniature heuchera bred especially for small containers, fairy gardens, and tight edging spaces.

directions: Plant in humus-rich, well-drained soil in partial to full shade; Little Cuties Peppermint is a miniature coral bells cultivar from the Proven Winners Little Cuties series, bred to stay notably smaller than standard heucheras, with crinkled, minty-green leaves overlaid with silvery highlights and fine dark veining on a diminutive mound just a few inches tall. Its tiny scale makes it ideal for small containers, fairy gardens, rock garden pockets, and tight edging spots where a full-sized heuchera would quickly overwhelm the space. Small flower spikes rise just above the foliage in late spring but are secondary to the compact, colorful leaf display. Provide consistent moisture and sharp drainage, and divide congested clumps every few years in spring to maintain vigor.
sources: Proven Winners — Heuchera Little Cuties Series
North Carolina State Extension — Heuchera for Southern Gardens
